adapter-entry-point.method: Accepted Workspace CLI Capability validation and clean staged Provider Entry Point generation

governed-target.method: Repository behavioral tests prove exact thesis, articulation version, complete active signal-set binding, a full linked claim/observation context with source content, prior evidence, and missing or stale target refusal

evidence-semantics-and-provenance.method: Repository behavioral tests enforce thesis-centric invalidation condition/effect pairs through the actual recorder input, prove direct-bearing requirements, neutral completeness, complete provenance and promoted-claim reuse, and compare observable writes from bound Claude and Codex fixtures

deterministic-recorder.method: Repository behavioral tests exercise the production database adapter boundary, prove serializable transaction configuration, the exact three-table write routing, rollback on failure, and no-write outcomes for invalid or changed targets

authority-boundary.method: Repository contract tests prove the exact adapter delegates its only mutation to the recorder and refuses status, Decision Item, claim creation, signal configuration, ad-hoc write, strategy, position, and trade authority

neutral-semantics.method: Compared the Codex adapter with issue #58's accepted contract, CONTEXT.md, the canonical assessment workflow's useful intent, and the governed thesis-underwriting dependency

eligible-environment.method: The configured repository runtime completed the non-mutating recorder --help preflight on 2026-08-08; database, source, provider, sandbox, or network unavailability remains an explicit unavailable result
